culprit_citations.quoted_text: Ratio of net investment income to average net assets (annualized) (2) | 12.68 | %

findings.detail: F16 fired with metric 9.632490031014623 even though source shows six-month distributions of 1.28 per share and an annualized net investment income ratio of 12.68%, so the distribution-rate comparison is mis-scaled or mis-periodized.

rationale: The raw filing financial highlights show total dividends declared of 1.28 per share for the six months ended June 30, 2024 and a ratio of net investment income to average net assets of 12.68% annualized. The operations table independently shows total dividends/distributions of 0.64 for the quarter and 1.28 for the six-month period. These source anchors do not support a distribution-rate-to-income-yield excess of 9.63249; the flag reflects a rate scaling or periodization defect in the extracted/check data, not an unsupported source value.
